Toggl uses cookies

We use cookies to personalise content and ads, to provide social media features and to analyse our traffic. We also share information about your use of our site with our social media, advertising and analytics partners who may combine it with other information that you’ve provided to them or that they’ve collected from your use of their services.

Detailed information on how we use cookies can be found in our Cookie Declaration and the Privacy Policies.

This Cookie Declaration applies to Toggl OÜ, Toggl Inc., and Toggl Technology Ltd (“Toggl”, “we”) and to the Toggl websites and applications.

Automated Time Tracking

Desktop activity tracking
Track apps and websites used for over 10 seconds and view them in a timeline. Your data stays private — you control which activities turn into time entries. Available on Windows and macOS desktop apps.
Split time logs
Split a time log into two in one click, from the time log menu or the calendar.
Auto track calendar events
Integrate with calendars and automatically turn events into time entries.
Auto track selected pages via browser extension
Select pages to auto-track via browser extension; tracking starts automatically after your chosen delay.
Automated tracking with keywords
Link keywords to designated projects, and trigger automatic notifications to track time on the project whenever the keyword appears in the foreground. Available on our Windows and macOS desktop apps.
Idle time detection
Idle detection sends you a prompt when your timer is running but there’s no computer activity. Available on our browser extension and desktop apps.

Data Compliance and Accuracy

Alerts
Set time estimate and budget alert thresholds for all projects. Alerts are emailed as soon as a threshold is reached.
Timesheet approvals
Submit and approve timesheets weekly or monthly, and lock approved periods from further edits. Admins can submit a timesheet for a member who’s away.
Lock time entries
Pick a date, and time entries on or before it can’t be changed. Admins and managers can still make a deliberate edit.
Required fields
Choose which fields must be filled in on tasks and time logs: project, task, description or tags.
Time tracking reminders
Remind team members to log their hours. Reminders are sent by email when someone’s tracked time falls below the target.
Audit log
A complete history of changes to your organization's data — see what changed, who made the change, and when, with the values before and after.

Personal reports

Summary, Time Logs reports
Summary: totals broken down by project, client, member, task, tag and more, with bar or donut charts and each row’s share of the total. Time Logs: every time log in full, for audits.
CSV imports
Import clients, projects, tasks, tags, members and time entries from any CSV file, whether it's an export from another tool or your own spreadsheet.
PDF exports

Team-level reports, with filters

Rounding

See how tracked time translates into revenue, costs, profit, and margins. Analyze performance across Projects, Clients, Tasks, Members, and Tags. Set a custom target margin to assess performance.

Fixed fees

Utilization and workload reports

Project dashboards
Track each project's budget and time progress in real time, with a forecast of when it will finish and breakdowns by task, member and status.
Custom fields
Add your own fields to projects, tasks and members, from dropdowns and text to numbers, dates, checkboxes and member pickers, then filter and group by them across reports and views.
Saved report views

Report sharing

External report sharing
Admins can create a view-only link to a report and send it to anyone, including people without a Toggl account.
Custom company logo
Add your company logo to PDF report exports, without the watermark.
Scheduled report emails
Email shared reports to workspace members, teams, or yourself, daily, weekly or monthly. The email links to the report, so recipients always see live numbers.
Toggl AI

FAQs

What project views does Toggl have?

A Board for Kanban-style status, a Task list, a Timeline that works as a Gantt chart, and a Calendar for dropping work onto specific days. Switching views rebuilds nothing as it's one set of tasks shown differently, and filters carry across when you switch. 

Can I see whether my plans matched reality with Toggl?

Yes. In Toggl, each task carries an estimate, your team tracks time against that same task, and the block shows planned against logged. Estimates versus actuals, workload, and utilization sit in reports. 

Does Toggl monitor employees or take screenshots?

No. Toggl doesn’t monitor employees, take screenshots, or record keystrokes, browsing history, or location. Toggl records how long work took and what it was for.  Saying no to surveillance is a deliberate product decision, because employee buy-in is what makes the data accurate in the first place.

Is Toggl free for freelancers?

Yes, and the free plan is built to be genuinely usable solo rather than a trial in disguise as it includes one-click tracking, focus mode, calendar integrations, and useful planning with boards, tasks, and task estimates. When you’re ready to upgrade, you get billable rates, timeline views, milestones, tags, and much more.

Is Toggl free for teams?

Yes, up to 3 users. The free tier includes manual and real-time timers, calendar integrations, and simple planning with tasks and boards. Beyond that, paid plans add the things many teams need, like approval workflows, billable rates, capacity planning, PTO, budgets and alerts, and the reporting depth that turns tracked hours into utilization and margin.

Can I keep my data in the EU?

Yes. When you sign up, choose EU as your data region and your application data is stored in Belgium. More about EU hosting.
